properties.data:
结果肝移植术后服用他克莫司合用伏立康唑，致其浓度升高，联用保钾利尿剂增加了其发生高钾血症不良反应的风险结论肝移植受者，在加用伏立康唑后，需严密监测他克莫司血药浓度、肝肾功能、电解质变化，及时调整他克莫司剂量，并尽量避免联合应用升高血钾药物。
Hyperkalemia induced by pharmacologic interaction between tacrolimus and other drugs after liver transplantation ZHOU Xiao-long 1 ，WEI Li-na 2 ，L Wen-wen1\* ( 1. Department of Pharmacy，Binzhou Medical University Hospital，Binzhou 256603，China; 2. Department of Pharmacy，Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University，Qingdao 266034，China)［Abstract］ Objective To investigate the clinical characteristics and treatment of hyperkalemia caused by tacrolimus after liver transplantation． Methods Clinical data of one patient diagnosed with hyperkalemia induced by tacrolimus following liver transplantation were collected and retrospectively analyzed． Results The concentration of tacrolimus was elevated after addition of voriconazole，and the risk of hyperkalemia was increased when potassium-sparing diuretics was used． Conclusion Tacrolimus blood concentration，liver and kidney function

Department of Pharmacy，Binzhou Medical University Hospital，Binzhou 256603，China; 2. Department of Pharmacy，Affiliated Hospital of Qingdao University，Qingdao 266034，China)［Abstract］ Objective To investigate the clinical characteristics and treatment of hyperkalemia caused by tacrolimus after liver transplantation． Methods Clinical data of one patient diagnosed with hyperkalemia induced by tacrolimus following liver transplantation were collected and retrospectively analyzed． Results The concentration of tacrolimus was elevated after addition of voriconazole，and the risk of hyperkalemia was increased when potassium-sparing diuretics was used． Conclusion Tacrolimus blood concentration，liver and kidney function，as well as electrolytes should be closely monitored after voriconazole is used． Moreover，the dose of tacrolimus should be adjusted timely and try to avoid combination use of drugs that induce hyperkalemia．
